base_cache_dir.description: Root directory for storing cached debug information files (object files, debug sections, etc.)

executable_cache_dir.description: Directory where downloaded debuginfo packages are extracted and stored as executables for linking

upstream_debuginfods.description: List of HTTP(S) URLs pointing to upstream debuginfod servers to query for debuginfo

port.description: TCP port on which the debuginfod HTTP server listens

bind_address.description: IP address to bind the server to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only, '' for all interfaces)

max_workers.description: Maximum number of worker threads to handle incoming requests

cache_size_limit.description: Maximum total size (in bytes) of the debuginfo cache; 0 means unlimited

cache_ttl.description: Time (in seconds) after which cached debuginfo is considered stale and evicted; 0 means never expire

compress_cache.description: Enable or disable compression of cached debuginfo files using Zstandard (zstd)

prune_cache.description: Automatically prune old and unused debuginfo entries from the cache

proxy_url.description: HTTP(S) proxy URL for outgoing requests (e.g., 'http://proxy.example.com:3128'); empty = direct

cacert_path.description: Path to custom CA certificate bundle for TLS; empty uses system trust store

tls_verify.description: Enforce strict TLS certificate verification for upstream connections

upstream_auth_users.description: List of credentials for authenticating to upstream debuginfod servers using HTTP Basic Auth

metrics_enabled.description: Expose a Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint at /metrics

log_file.description: Path to write log output; empty means write to stderr

max_downloads_per_client.description: Maximum number of concurrent downloads allowed per client IP

max_upstream_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections to upstream debuginfod servers

upstream_connection_ttl.description: Time (seconds) to keep an idle upstream connection open in the pool

supported_protocols.description: List of debuginfod API versions to support (typically 'v1' and/or 'v2')

compress_responses.description: Enable gzip compression for HTTP responses (unless client explicitly disables via Accept-Encoding)

upstream_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for upstream HTTP requests before timing out

upstream_keepalive.description: Enable HTTP keep-alive for upstream connections to reduce latency
